name: python_off_by_one_pagination
prompt:
Fix the Python pagination off-by-one bug.

Requirements:
- Modify pagination.py only.
- paginate must reject page numbers less than 1.
- paginate must reject per_page values less than 1.
- Page 1 must return the first per_page items when available.
- Later pages must return exactly per_page items when enough items remain.
- The final partial page must return the remaining items.
- Pages beyond the end must return an empty list.
- Do not modify main.py.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only paginate changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: python main.py
